posts.author: ViktorRocha
posts.body:
Hi! I just came back from (literal) years out of the community, but i'm working in some clothes for RPG Maker MV, check it out:
But first things First... TERMS OF USE:
- Of course you need a LEGAL copy of RPG Maker.
- Credits to Kadokawa.
- You can use any of those freely, in comercial and uncommercial games.
- Feel free to edit anything that you feel need.
-Some edits used other creators designs, like Hiddenone, Pearl, Maigs. For those, needs Credits for them (I'll put in the specifics edits the names to properly credit).
- Don't need to credit me, but would be nice If you do so. And also nice If You share some photos from your game using any of those edits. Even nicer If You share your game with me (not mandatory).
Now, here It goes the examples:
As soon as they're ready i'll post the parts compatible with the generator here.
Those are my first tries, so please take it ease on me
